changes: DT-FM 1.2.1 (tag v1.2.1, 9ac1802), imported unchanged: glue.s, digitakt.c, sophie.c and their headers and tables. A four-operator FM SRC machine in slot 9, drawn by Machine Pages (a cm_ui_v31 page) and rendered through its ev_render_voices event; ev_tick runs its operator bookkeeping.

build.json is the author's mod.json: core_machines at order 90, ev_tick at order 10, ev_render_voices at order 20, requires machine-pages. Its four sites (project save and load, kit save and load) became address, length and SHA-256 guards; the 1.54 release adds -DOS154 and defsym OS154.

The library builds the author's released dt-fm-1.2.1-os1.53.elemod and -os1.54.elemod (sdk/imports/elekloader-dt-fm-2026-11-27.json), the files the author tested; Modwerk publishes no compiled package of its own. src/digitakt-mk1/core3.h is Machine Pages' copy of the header the author built against.
transformations: None to the author's files. Stock bytes in mod.json's sites became SHA-256 guards in build.json.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata. glue.s re-runs the two or three instructions each hooked entry replaced, as authored code.
